question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH wholesale_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        STRFTIME(CAST(vd.whsle_date AS DATE), '%Y') as year,
        AVG(vd."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX(vd."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as max_wholesale_price,
        MIN(vd."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as min_wholesale_price,
        SUM(vd."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as total_wholesale_price,
        AVG(vl."loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_whsle_df vd
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vd.item_code = vc.item_code
    JOIN veg_loss_rate_df vl ON vd.item_code = vl.item_code
    WHERE STRFTIME(CAST(vd.whsle_date AS DATE), '%Y') IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')
    GROUP BY vc.category_name, STRFTIME(CAST(vd.whsle_date AS DATE), '%Y')
),
selling_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        STRFTIME(CAST(vt.txn_date AS DATE), '%Y') as year,
        SUM(vt."qty_sold(kg)" * vt."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df vt
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vt.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE STRFTIME(CAST(vt.txn_date AS DATE), '%Y') IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')
    GROUP BY vc.category_name, STRFTIME(CAST(vt.txn_date AS DATE), '%Y')
)
SELECT 
    wa.category_name,
    wa.year,
    ROUND(wa.avg_wholesale_price, 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wa.max_wholesale_price, 2) as max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wa.min_wholesale_price, 2) as min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wa.max_wholesale_price - wa.min_wholesale_price, 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(wa.total_wholesale_price, 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(sa.total_selling_price, 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(wa.avg_loss_rate, 2) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(wa.total_wholesale_price * wa.avg_loss_rate / 100, 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(sa.total_selling_price - wa.total_wholesale_price, 2) as profit
FROM wholesale_agg wa
JOIN selling_agg sa ON wa.category_name = sa.category_name AND wa.year = sa.year
ORDER BY wa.year, wa.category_name
